article.story: No. 19 Ole Miss (6-3) at Oklahoma (5-4), Nov. 14 at 4:15 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Ole Miss by 2.5. Against the spread: Ole Miss 4-5, Oklahoma 4-5. How to watch: SEC Network Key stats Ole Miss Offense Overall: 418.8 yards per game (40th in FBS) Passing: 271.4 yards per game (23rd) Rushing: 147.3 yards per game (80th) Scoring: 33.8 points per game (30th) Ole Miss Defense Overall: 394.7 yards per game (104th in FBS) Passing: 229.6 yards per game (97th) Rushing: 165.1 yards per game (94th) Scoring: 26.0 points per game (79th) Oklahoma Offense Overall: 338.4 yards per game (113th in FBS) Passing: 227.6 yards per game (73rd) Rushing: 110.9 yards per game (124th) Scoring: 22.1 points per game (108th) Oklahoma Defense Overall: 293.3 yards per game (16th in FBS) Passing: 170.7 yards per game (11th) Rushing: 122.7 yards per game (37th) Scoring: 19.2 points per game (23rd) Ole Miss ranks 120th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 43.8% of third downs. Oklahoma is 114th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 78.3% of trips. Ole Miss' red zone defense ranks 37th at 78.4%. Ole Miss is 130th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:13, compared to Oklahoma's 44th-ranked average of 31:03. Team leaders Ole Miss Passing: Trinidad Chambliss, 2,359 yards, 18 TDs, 9 INTs, 62.7 completion percentage Rushing: Kewan Lacy, 388 yards on 78 carries, 5 TDs Receiving: Deuce Alexander, 669 yards on 48 catches, 5 TDs Oklahoma Passing: John Mateer, 2,042 yards, 15 TDs, 7 INTs, 65.4 completion percentage Rushing: Lloyd Avant, 394 yards on 92 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Isaiah Sategna III, 625 yards on 49 catches, 4 TDs Last game Ole Miss was beaten by Georgia 42-7 on Nov. 7. Chambliss led Ole Miss with 170 yards on 18-of-34 passing (52.9%) for no touchdowns and one interception. Shekai Mills-Knight carried the ball 13 times for 52 yards and scored one touchdown, adding two receptions for 15 yards. Horatio Fields put up 96 yards on eight catches. Oklahoma beat Florida 23-7 on Nov. 7. Mateer led Oklahoma with 207 yards on 21-of-33 passing (63.6%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball 14 times for 56 yards. Avant carried the ball 13 times for 47 yards, adding one reception for six yards. Rocky Beers put up 72 yards on four catches. Next game Ole Miss hosts Wofford on Nov. 21. Oklahoma hosts Texas A&M on Nov. 21.
